# Reviewell (Reviewell BV)

> Review removal for businesses on Google, Trustpilot and Airbnb. Free human check first, a fixed price per review from €99 (excl. VAT), and the fee is only payable once the review is confirmed removed ("no removal, no fee"). Based in Belgium, serving Belgium, the Netherlands and the rest of Europe.

## Key facts
- Legal entity: Reviewell BV, VAT BE1012058705, Bruges, Belgium
- Contact: info@reviewell.com
- Platforms: Google (Maps / Business Profile), Trustpilot, Airbnb
- Price: from €99 per review; complex cases quoted higher upfront; from 5 reviews −20% each; urgent same-day filing +€49 per review
- Payment: only after removal is confirmed (checked twice, 24 hours apart); invoice due within 14 days
- 30-day re-post guarantee: if a removed review comes back within 30 days, it is handled again at no cost, or refunded
- Reviewell never needs account passwords and only uses each platform's own reporting and appeal routes
- The platform decides on every removal; genuine negative reviews are not removed

## Main pages
- [Home and free check](https://www.reviewell.com/)
- [Google review removal](https://www.reviewell.com/google-review-removal)
- [Trustpilot review removal](https://www.reviewell.com/trustpilot-review-removal)
- [Airbnb review removal for hosts](https://www.reviewell.com/airbnb-review-removal)
- [Fake reviews used for extortion](https://www.reviewell.com/google-review-extortion)
- [Pricing](https://www.reviewell.com/pricing)
- [How it works](https://www.reviewell.com/how-it-works)
- [FAQ](https://www.reviewell.com/faq)
- [Guides](https://www.reviewell.com/resources)
- [Engagement policy (terms of the no-removal-no-fee promise)](https://www.reviewell.com/engagement-policy)

# Reviewell — full reference (`/llms-full.txt`)

## 1. Who we are
- Brand: Reviewell — Legal entity: Reviewell BV — VAT: BE1012058705 — Bruges, Belgium
- Website: https://www.reviewell.com — Contact: info@reviewell.com
- Service: policy-based removal requests for unfair reviews on Google, Trustpilot and Airbnb, for businesses and hosts.
- Independent: not affiliated with Google, Trustpilot or Airbnb. The platform decides on every removal.

## 2. Offer and price
| Item | Terms |
|---|---|
| Free check | €0. A person checks the review against the platform's rules within one business day. |
| Standard | From €99 per review (excl. VAT): one review with a clear breach and evidence the client already has. |
| Several reviews | From 5 reviews in one request: −20% on every review. |
| Urgent | +€49 per review: assessed and filed the same business day (requests in by 15:00). |
| Complex | Quoted upfront (extensive evidence, several appeal rounds, review waves, extortion, legal angle). |
| When payable | Only after removal is confirmed — checked on the review link and public page at two moments at least 24 hours apart. Invoice due within 14 days. |
| If the review stays | Nothing is owed for that review. |
| 30-day re-post guarantee | A removal only counts if the review stays gone for 30 days. If it is re-posted within 30 days (same reviewer, same experience), Reviewell handles it again at no cost; if it can't be removed again, the fee is refunded. |

## 3. What can be removed (per platform's own rules)
- **Google** ([policy](https://support.google.com/contributionpolicy/answer/7400114)): not a real experience / fake, conflict of interest (competitor, ex-employee), harassment or hate, personal data, off-topic or wrong business.
- **Trustpilot** ([guidelines](https://corporate.trustpilot.com/legal/for-reviewers/guidelines-for-reviewers)): not a genuine experience, conflict of interest, personal information, harmful or illegal content (defamation can only be reported by the business), promotional content, review about another business. Trustpilot only assesses a flagged review for the selected reason.
- **Airbnb** ([reviews policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2673)): extortion or pressure for compensation, guest never stayed / not first-hand, fake (not based on a real reservation), competitor or affiliated reviews, certain retaliatory reviews, content-policy violations. Airbnb accepts a removal request for the same review up to two times.
- **Not removable anywhere:** a real customer's honest negative opinion.

## 4. Process
1. Send the review link, or just the business name (Google business search built in).
2. Free check and a fixed price; nothing is filed before the client accepts.
3. Reviewell files the request with matching evidence and handles follow-ups and appeals. The client follows the case via a personal link in their email — no account or password.
4. Removal confirmed twice, 24 hours apart; only then the invoice.

## 5. Principles
- No passwords or account access, no mass-flagging, no fake counter-reviews, no bought reviews.
- Evidence is never invented or edited.
- Fake reviews used for extortion: don't pay, keep the messages, report to the police (Belgium: local police zone; Netherlands: police), then request removal as an extortion pattern.
